description: The nth companion Pell-Lucas number. Q0 and Q1 are both 2, and later terms use the Pell recurrence. An optional modulus reduces the term, and zero is rejected. n runs from 0 to 8192. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/pell-lucas
